transcript: A small concert was held in the town hall Whoever came could enter with free admission Whoever performed was warmly welcomed by the audience The first to perform was a girl of ten holding a violin When she finished, however softly she played Every note reached the listeners in the room Applause rose several times Whichever movement she played Her tone was pure Whoever listened could not help but admire the purity of her sound That evening, the hall was more peaceful than I had ever seen And people exchanged smile after smile with one another This kind of place, whenever it exists Is a small community tradition that I want to treasure

segments.text: A small concert was held in the town hall
Whoever came could enter with free admission
Whoever performed was warmly welcomed by the audience
The first to perform was a girl of ten holding a violin
When she finished, however softly she played
Every note reached the listeners in the room
Whoever listened could not help but admire the purity of her sound
That evening, the hall was more peaceful than I had ever seen
And people exchanged smile after smile with one another
This kind of place, whenever it exists
Is a small community tradition that I want to treasure
